```yaml
name: Sync Wiki and Manage Releases

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'current/docs/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'current/docs/**'

jobs:
  sync-wiki:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: repo
          
      - name: Setup wiki repo
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/jpicklyk/task-orchestrator.wiki.git wiki
          cd wiki
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
      - name: Copy docs to wiki
        run: |
          cd repo
          cp -r current/docs/* ../wiki/
          
      - name: Commit and push wiki changes
        run: |
          cd wiki
          git add .
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Sync docs from repo"
          git push origin main
          
  test-and-build:
    needs: sync-wiki
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: repo
          
      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          
      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v2
        
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd repo
          ./gradlew :current:test
          
  publish-docker:
    needs: test-and-build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: repo
          
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
        
      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
          
      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: jpicklyk/task-orchestrator
          
      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: repo
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          
      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v6
        with:
          config-name: release-config.yml
          publish: true
          tag: v${{ github.sha }}
          name: Release ${{ github.sha }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          
  prepare-release:
    needs: publish-docker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: repo
          
      - name: Setup Melos
        uses: bluefireteam/melos-action@v3
        with:
          melos-version: '3.0.0'
          dart-version: '3.0.0'
          run-bootstrap: true
          
      - name: Calculate version bump
        run: |
          cd repo
          # Get commits since last tag
          LAST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "v0.0.0")
          COMMITS_SINCE_LAST_TAG=$(git log --oneline ${LAST_TAG}..HEAD | wc -l)
          
          if [ "$COMMITS_SINCE_LAST_TAG" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Commits since last tag: $COMMITS_SINCE_LAST_TAG"
            # Create release branch
            NEW_VERSION="v$(date +%Y.%m.%d)"
            git checkout -b "release/${NEW_VERSION}"
            echo "RELEASE_VERSION=${NEW_VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi
          
      - name: Create release branch
        if: env.RELEASE_VERSION != ''
        run: |
          cd repo
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Prepare release ${RELEASE_VERSION}"
          git push origin "release/${RELEASE_VERSION}"
          
  cleanup:
    needs: [sync-wiki, test-and-build, publish-docker, prepare-release]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Cleanup
        run: |
          echo "Workflow completed"
```
